title: mimid: Room/create per the revised rule (roomId argument, room_metadata optional)
description: Implement the draft change: accept a roomId argument, refuse a room_metadata whose room_uri differs, accept rooms without room_metadata. Update tools/interop/chat to create rooms without metadata when inviting users whose KeyPackages don't list 0x0023, then rerun jmap-erin.script against Haven to show erin can be invited.
